$description: DEPRECATED 2026-07-10. This file's content (knowledge-wiki baseline DTCG bundle: additive primitives, semantic layer, component layer for the wiki/article-domain component family) has been consolidated into the canonical copy at repo-root tokens/dtcg-bundle.json, which was independently confirmed to be the actively-maintained superset (358 leaves vs. this file's 148; 107 shared paths identical, 36 more were this file's pre-refactor dotted-key naming for values root already carries under its current hyphenated convention, and the 5 genuinely new GIS cluster-degree colors were folded into root under primitive.color.cluster-degree1..5). See .agent/drafts-outbound/DESIGN-TOKEN-CHANGE-dtcg-bundle-reconciliation.draft.md for the full reconciliation record and .agent/briefs/BRIEF-design-pointsav-v3-ground-up-rethink.md (Phase 4a.8/4a.9) for why this consolidation does NOT touch design.pointsav.com's own served tokens: those come exclusively from dtcg-vault/tokens/primitive.json + dtcg-vault/themes/pointsav-brand.json via the separate exports/tokens.full.json pipeline. This bundle was never part of that pipeline — sync-design-tokens.sh has always explicitly skipped it by filename (SKIP = {"dtcg-bundle.json", ...}), on both sides of this deprecation, so no production behavior changes as a result of this file becoming a stub. Root's copy is a genuine cross-domain bundle (wiki/article components + app-workplace-* products + shared numeric primitives), not a duplicate of the substrate's own primitive/theme layer, and continues to be consumed directly by its downstream apps.
